v1_preservation_rule: Runtime Contract V1 remains immutable historical architecture evidence. No V1 standing, exact-SHA evidence or future qualification may be relabeled as proving V2 semantics.
purpose: Provide the single Book-parent-owned intake and proposal-admission path for typed service responses while preserving exact identity, editorial responsibility, target-medium proof separation, provenance currentness, rights/privacy, author authority and non-success states; prevent any provider, document engine, provenance credential or technical proof result from directly mutating canonical Book state, advancing lifecycle state or authorizing publication.

implementation_block.reason: The current registered Document/Export response surface does not yet expose all research-verified format-validation, source-to-render, accessibility, proof/correction and provenance evidence needed for V2 end-to-end enforcement.
implementation_block.no_local_substitute: Book System must not bypass this block by implementing document-generation/validation machinery inside the Book runtime.

immutable_proposal_snapshot.version_rule: Every admission-state, currentness, rights/privacy, editorial-stage, artifact or provenance material change creates a new immutable proposal snapshot with predecessor lineage; an old snapshot is never rewritten in place.

intake_rules: The original registered request and response are required for intake.
Request/response service, operation, request_id, correlation_id and idempotency_key must match exactly.
Provider class must match the registered service provider class and provider subject identity must be preserved.
Response parent_projection_identity must exactly match the request projection identity.
All source object, manuscript, artifact and provenance identities used for admission must bind exact immutable versions/digests rather than floating latest references.
A stale parent projection is preserved but cannot create or advance a proposal until explicit parent revalidation.

A superseded manuscript/source version, changed artifact digest, changed target-medium profile or superseded provenance projection stales the affected proposal until explicit parent revalidation under the new identities.
Provider-supplied canonical-write, lifecycle-transition, admission, author-approval or publication-authority claims are forbidden and fail closed.

Document/Export SUCCESS, artifact generation, FORMAT_VALIDATED, POST_LAYOUT_PROOF_COMPLETE, provenance validation or credential verification are evidence states only and never imply EXPORT_FROZEN or PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZED.
Imported W3C PROV/C2PA or other external provenance is evidence-only until normal Book parent intake/admission requirements are satisfied.
SUCCESS is not admission. PARTIAL, ABSTAIN, ERROR, uncertainty and disagreement remain first-class durable states.
Private manuscript/evaluation/research content must not be copied into external provenance merely to satisfy an interoperability field; minimum-necessary disclosure remains the default.

required_when_stage_scoped: required exit evidence refs or explicit unresolved state
narrative consistency regression refs where required
upstream defect routing refs if later-stage scope discovers an earlier-stage defect
law: A provider cannot self-declare an editorial stage complete for canonical lifecycle advancement.
A later stage cannot silently widen its edit authority to repair an upstream structural/line defect.
NOT_APPLICABLE requires recorded rationale and cannot conceal unresolved required evidence.
Runtime V2 stores and gates proposal evidence; it does not claim Lifecycle Transition Engine v1 already enforces new executable substage semantics.

document_export_boundary.execution_owner: DOCUMENT SYSTEM or a Document-System-owned provider implementing the registered interface
document_export_boundary.book_system_owns: source/canonical identity, target profile selection, book-semantic requirements, acceptance/rejection, export freeze and publication authority
rules: The states are ordered responsibility boundaries and must not be collapsed.
FORMAT_VALIDATED requires the selected format/profile evidence but is not proof completion.
POST_LAYOUT_PROOF_COMPLETE requires exact rendered/export candidate evidence and source-to-render integrity evidence under the selected target-medium profile.
Any correction that changes artifact bytes creates a new artifact digest and invalidates downstream proof/currentness until revalidated.
Any correction that changes canonical manuscript text routes upstream to Book canonical versioning before another export request.
EXPORT_FROZEN is a Book-parent state and PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZED requires separate explicit Book/author authority.
Book Runtime V2 must not implement a duplicate PDF/DOCX/EPUB/print renderer, converter, validator, accessibility checker or credential embedder.
External provenance cannot mutate canonical Book state or create admission automatically.
External credential/signature validation cannot establish factual truth, literary quality, authorship beyond supported attribution evidence, author approval or publication authorization.
A provenance projection is current only for its exact source parent state, source-object versions/digests and artifact digest.
Superseded provenance remains historical evidence and cannot be silently rebound to new bytes or a new manuscript version.
If attaching a credential changes artifact bytes, the credentialed artifact receives a new final digest and the pre-credential digest remains predecessor identity.
Rights/privacy reclassification may stale, redact, reject or withdraw external projection eligibility without erasing immutable prior internal evidence.

parent_registration.rule: Runtime V2 may register immutable proposal/evidence references and increment parent state version transactionally, but canonical pointers, lifecycle transitions, export freeze and publication authorization remain separate parent authorities.

EVIDENCE_REVIEWED: required source/evidence/artifact/provenance references are present and current for the review scope
rights/privacy boundaries are known and acceptable
PARTIAL may advance only with preserved limitations and parent review classification
PARENT_PREQUALIFIED: proposal source projection and all material source/artifact/provenance identities have been revalidated against current parent state
required independent evaluation, narrative-consistency regression, prior-stage regression or qualification refs are present when the applicable capability contract requires them
ADMITTED: all required author decisions are explicitly APPROVED when required
admission creates bounded capability/evidence eligibility only and does not promote manuscript, advance lifecycle, freeze export or authorize publication

author_handoff.trigger: response requested_parent_action=QUEUE_AUTHOR_DECISION or proposal requires explicit author authority before admission/use
author_handoff.rule: Runtime V2 may queue a decision requirement but cannot fill the author's choice, mark approval, or manufacture an AUTHOR_DECISION record.

staleness_and_invalidation.parent_state_change: Stale for admission until explicit parent revalidation.
staleness_and_invalidation.source_object_or_manuscript_change: Stale for admission; old snapshot remains historical and cannot be rebound.
staleness_and_invalidation.artifact_digest_or_target_profile_change: Artifact/proof evidence becomes stale until the changed artifact/profile is revalidated and re-proved as applicable.
staleness_and_invalidation.provenance_projection_change: Old projection remains historical but is stale for current release/admission use unless explicitly revalidated against exact current identities.
staleness_and_invalidation.rights_privacy_change: Affected intake/proposals become stale or rejected under the new boundary; historical evidence is retained.
staleness_and_invalidation.provider_subject_change: New provider output requires new intake identity; prior success cannot be rebound to a new provider subject SHA.
staleness_and_invalidation.revalidation: Parent-owned revalidation creates a new immutable proposal snapshot; old snapshots are never edited in place.

transactionality.intake_commit: Intake ledger update plus any new parent PROPOSED registration commits atomically; on failure neither is committed.
transactionality.admission_commit: New proposal snapshot plus parent registration plus admission receipt commit atomically; on failure the prior snapshot remains current.

required_v2_registry_delta: register editorial-stage context/evidence outputs where provider operations participate in structural/line/copy/proof gates
expand Document/Export request projection to bind exact source version+digest, target-medium profile, accessibility/proof requirements and publication_authorized=false
expand Document/Export response evidence for format validation, source-to-render integrity, accessibility where applicable, proof/correction state and artifact digest/currentness
register optional provenance attachment/validation evidence without giving provenance providers canonical or publication authority
preserve result-class, idempotency, rights/privacy and exact-provider identity semantics

qualification_objective_after_dependenci: Implement Runtime V2 only after Service Interface Registry V2 is admitted; then prove exact request/response/provider/source/artifact/provenance identity, non-success preservation, editorial-gate evidence boundaries, technical-export/publication separation, stale-source/artifact/provenance rejection, immutable proposals, author handoff, atomic commits/rollback and no provider-to-canon/lifecycle/export-freeze/publication backdoor on one exact implementation SHA.
qualification_effect: NONE until the changed service registry and executable Runtime V2 implementation receive their own applicable exact-subject qualification.
